bugs_found: transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/string inputs can pass some checks then fail mid-operation or return mixed-type Receipt amounts
transfer is not atomic: debit occurs before credit, so a failure during account_to.balance + amount can leave account_from debited
transfer does not validate account balances/currencies/amount are finite Decimals; NaN/Infinity can poison balances or bypass intended money invariants
fx_convert does not validate rate is positive and finite, allowing zero, negative, NaN, or Infinity exchange rates to produce invalid money amounts
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year with int(), causing undeclared behavior changes for fractional or string-like numeric inputs
compound_interest does not validate principal is non-negative or finite, allowing negative/NaN/Infinity financial amounts
apply_fee does not reject fee_pct > 1, so fees can exceed the amount and return a negative net amount when fee_max permits it
apply_fee does not validate all monetary inputs are finite Decimals, allowing NaN/Infinity propagation
